display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Structured Logging (redacted, requestId context)
Prometheus Metrics + Grafana Dashboards
OpenTelemetry Distributed Tracing
Security Alerts (breach detection)
Incident Response Runbooks
Quarterly DR Drills

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Encryption at Rest (MongoDB + AES-256)
Encryption in Transit (TLS 1.3)
Secrets Hashed at Rest (SHA-256)
HSM / KMS for Signing Keys
Tamper-Evident Audit Log Chain (SHA-256)
Never Log Passwords, Tokens, OTPs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deny-by-Default
RBAC (roles + permissions, tenant-scoped)
ABAC (attribute-based policies)
Tenant Isolation (all queries scoped)
Permission Checks Server-Side
IDOR / BOLA Prevention
Identity derived from verified JWT, never client body

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Short-lived Access Tokens (15 min)
Rotating Refresh Tokens (one-time use)
Refresh Reuse → Family Revocation (atomic)
HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite Cookies
JWKS Key Rotation (kid-based, 30-day)
Key State Machine: Generated → Active → Verify-Only → Retired → Revoked

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Argon2id Password Hashing (64 MiB, t=3, p=1)
Asymmetric JWT Signing (RS256, ES256, EdDSA)
MFA: TOTP + WebAuthn/FIDO2 + Backup Codes
Account Lockout (5 attempts → 15 min lock)
Brute Force Protection (per-IP + per-user)
Enumeration-Safe Flows (decoy tokens)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CORS Strict Allowlist (never wildcard with credentials)
CSRF Double-Submit Cookies (SameSite=Lax)
Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff)
Input Validation (Zod schemas)
NoSQL Injection Prevention
Body Size Cap (100 KB default)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TLS 1.3 (TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384)
DDoS Protection (Cloudflare / AWS Shield)
Web Application Firewall (WAF)
IP Whitelisting / Blocklisting
Edge Rate Limiting (10k RPS burst)
